_comment: Reference values for rdkit-mol-standardize (RDKit 2024.9.5, SDMolSupplier -> LargestFragmentChooser -> Uncharger -> canonical isomeric dedup). Deterministic; calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: Verifier replays the pinned recipe and compares the standardized set exactly (plus sorted-order and no-duplicates checks); refs pin the replayed counts as drift anchors. 5 oracle runs identical (spread 0). Asset integrity: sha256 of messy.sdf pinned and validated before replay (P2 B1 convention); cheat_asset_tamper.sh confirms a tampered asset is a hard fail.
